description: The name-based handler-param seed (`cmd`, `input`, `payload`, ...) stands in for callers the scan cannot see. A helper whose callers are all in view gets its inbound taint from them: literal-only callers make no finding, a route caller makes one finding at the call site, and an exported function with no caller keeps the seed.

expected.notes: run and readInput are only called with literals
deploy has a caller in view, so its flow is reported at that call, not again from the payload param
no caller of the exported function is in view, so the userCommand param is seeded
